actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
    p.vendor,
    p.barcode,
    p.title,
    p.variant,
    CONCAT(p.content_amount, ' ', p.content_unit) AS content,
    p.quantity,
    p.inventory_tracked AS tracked,
    p.inventory_policy AS policy

FROM public.products p

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        barcode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            barcode,
            supplier,
            MAX(quantity) AS quantity
        FROM public.supplier_inventory
        GROUP BY barcode, supplier
    ) x
    GROUP BY barcode
) s
    ON p.barcode = s.barcode

WHERE p.barcode IS NOT NULL
  AND p.barcode <> ''
  AND s.barcode IS NULL

  AND (
      '{{SelectVendor.selectedOptionValue}}' = ''
      OR p.vendor = '{{SelectVendor.selectedOptionValue}}'
  )

  AND (
      '{{SelectCategory.selectedOptionValue}}' = ''
      OR p.category = '{{SelectCategory.selectedOptionValue}}'
  )

ORDER BY p.vendor, p.title;
